newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Misuari takes oath as south Philippines governor.
newsitem.headline: Misuari takes oath as south Philippines governor.

text.p: Former rebel chief Nur Misuari, who plunged the southern Philippines into a bloody civil war, took office on Monday as governor of a semi-autonomous Moslem region.
Misuari, pledging to abide by and defend the Philippine constitution, was sworn into office for a three-year term by President Fidel Ramos in a formal ceremony in Cotabato city.

The chairman of the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) recently signed a peace deal with Manila ending a 24-year Moslem separatist war that killed more than 120,000 people. He was elected regional governor on September 9.
